title: Ugreen’s 100W 4-port GaN charger drops 27% today
summary: Whether you need to charge a laptop before work, top up your smartphone, or keep your tablet ready for travel, this four-port Ugreen GaN charger delivers up to 100W via USB Type-C and is currently $15 cheaper on Amazon.
body: A dedicated charging solution is a great way to declutter your desk and keep your essential gadgets charged whenever you need them. If you are looking for one, don’t miss this deal on the Ugreen Nexode 100W GaN wall charger. Currently on sale at 27% off on Amazon, the charging adapter is $39.98, down from its original price of $54.99 . Thanks to its high power output, it can charge multiple devices at once, making it suitable for your smartphone, tablet, and even your laptop. Check out the deal on Amazon The Ugreen Nexode 100W is a Gallium Nitride (GaN) charger that replaces internal silicon components with a highly efficient semiconductor capable of handling higher voltages. At the same time, it runs cooler and shrinks the power adapter's overall size by up to half. With a foldable plug design, this charger is also compact, making it the perfect companion for your next vacation or business trip. Nexode 100W charger: was $54.99 now $39.98 The Ugreen Nexode 100W GaN charger features three USB Type-C ports, one USB Type-A port, and a foldable plug, making it a convenient way to charge multiple gadgets without carrying separate adapters.
